summary_en: Annual dividend FY3/27 revised to ¥81/share (¥56 ordinary + ¥25 special interim) from prior forecast of ¥56/share. Special dividend marks 25th anniversary of medical device manufacturing operations (started 2001). Record date 30 September 2026.
title_en: Notice of Revisions to Dividend Forecasts (Mid-Year Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Japan Lifeline announced on 30 July 2026 a revision to its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027. The board approved a special interim commemorative dividend of ¥25 per share to mark the 25th anniversary of the company's medical device manufacturing operations (launched 2001 with its first in-house product, a PTCA guidewire). The revised annual dividend forecast is ¥81 per share (¥56 ordinary + ¥25 special), compared to the prior forecast of ¥56 per share issued on 7 May 2026. The prior year (FY3/26) annual dividend was ¥54 per share. The special dividend has a record date of 30 September 2026. The company cited the milestone anniversary as an opportunity to express gratitude to long-term shareholders.
